chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ السَّيِّدُ الْمُعَظَّمُ: مِنْ كِتَابِ أَبِي الْحُسَيْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْغَضَائِرِيِّ، الْمَقْصُورِ عَلَى ذِكْرِ الضُّعَفَاءِ، وَمَنْ رَدَّ حَدِيثَهُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَلَى حُرُوفِ الْمُعْجَمِ.

translations.en: The honored Sayyid said: From the book of Abū al-Ḥusayn Aḥmad b. al-Ḥusayn b. ʿUbaydullāh al-Ghaḍā’irī, restricted to the mention of the weak (narrators), and he whose ḥadīth has been rejected from our companions, in alphabetical order.

en.summary: This passage serves as the title or introductory identification for al-Ghaḍā’irī’s seminal work, *Kitab al-Du’afa’*, which systematically catalogs weak narrators (*munkar al-hadith*) whose reports were scrutinized by Shia scholars. By organizing these figures alphabetically, the text establishes a rigorous methodological framework for evaluating the reliability of the transmission chain, a critical concern in Shia hadith sciences for distinguishing authentic teachings from those requiring caution.
en.seo_question: What is the subject matter of al-Ghaḍā’irī's book on weak narrators?
